name: ServerBuddy
description: ServerBuddy: a toolkit for server owners — kits, shop, crates, menus (GUIs), announcements, cleanup, events, redeem codes, reward storage, logs, situational MOTD, chest-menu tags, trivia, missions (with global missions), battle pass, essentials (homes, warps, tpa, moderation, chat format...), chat manager, command blocking and Flan claim entry by permission or tag. With Cobblemon installed it also enables hunts, bosses, catch areas, catch combo, Pokédex, the Pokémon editor, tokens (Shiny, Gender and Shiny Ball), /pokesee, /compsee and the move blacklist.
contributors: PokeSkies (Stampede and contributors): code of the GUIs, Kits, Shop, Crates, Announcements and Clear modules
